presentation.introduction: AI is already part of our phones, classrooms, workplaces and media. What should we welcome, question or limit? Explore eight everyday and societal dilemmas together.
presentation.privacyNotice: Use fictional examples whenever you prefer. Do not share passwords, private messages, photographs or personal information with an AI tool during this lesson.
